job.title: Fund Accounting & Administration, AVP
job.sourceEmployerName: STATE STREET FUND SERVICES (SINGAPORE) PTE. LIMITED

details.sanitizedJobDescription:
Why this role is important to us

With more than US$1 trillion in assets under administration and over 3,500 employees exclusively focused on alternative asset servicing, State Street delivers industry-leading alternative asset services to clients worldwide. We provide a complete suite of fund accounting, fund administration, corporate administration, risk and credit services to more than 500 clients, including institutional investors, hedge fund, private equity fund and real estate fund managers. Our team of alternative investment professionals has more than 20 years of experience working with leading alpha-generating funds and combines extensive product expertise with flexible and innovative solutions specifically designed for alternative investments.

An opportunity has become available for suitable candidate to join our Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS) team in Singapore. The primary client account for this role is a leading global fund manager with a growing pan-Asian real estate platform with USD 5 billion of assets in Asia. This role is also expected to support other real estate and private equity funds and clients.

What you will be responsible for

i) Client Engagement

Strengthen client relationships. Take ownership of client communication and prompt follow up of service requests

Manage client expectations. Participate in discussions with both existing clients and prospects

Ensure the timeliness and accuracy of client deliverables in accordance with agreed service standards

Coordinate with clients’ internal stakeholders and other service providers including auditors, corporate secretary, law firms, banks and property accountants to ensure smooth service delivery.

Understand fund agreements and documents. Guide staff on the understanding and application of key terms

Advise clients on relevant accounting and reporting matters

ii) Service Delivery

Ensure monthly and quarterly client deliverables meet or exceed clients’ expectation:

Prepare/review management accounts, financial statements and other deliverables including NAV calculations, capital call & distribution notices, fee calculations and investor requests

Coordinate annual audit and tax return preparation with external accounting firms

Respond to ad hoc client requests and queries promptly

Review fund governing agreements and offering memorandums to ensure alignment of operational and accounting procedures

Prepare and maintain robust operational processes and internal controls in accordance with State Street policies

iii) Management

Manage staff to successful and timely completion of client deliverables.

Set goals and career development plans for direct reports in accordance with State Street’s performance planning process. Provide regular feedback and guidance to develop staff

Manage the quality of deliverables from offshore centers of excellence

Coordinate effectively with various internal service teams on client deliverables

Oversee the risk management and compliance of accounting processes.

Initiate and manage ongoing process improvement

Coordinate with other global locations on corporate initiatives and deliverables

iv) Other Responsibilities

Coordinate and manage special client and corporate projects

Internal reporting

What we value

Strong knowledge of private equity and real estate fund accounting

Strong client relations and team management skills

Team player with a proactive and positive approach to work

Hands-on, meticulous and resourceful

Problem solving and technical skills to handle complex transactions and structures

Organizational and project management skills to multi-task in a fast paced environment

Familiarity with Investran would be viewed favorably

Proficient in Microsoft Office with advanced MS Excel skills.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Degree in accountancy. Professional accounting qualification

10 years of accounting experience including with private equity and/or real estate funds, part of which must have been in a managerial role.

Sound knowledge of FRS/IFRS.

Prior process improvement and system implementation experience would be viewed favorably.

Additional qualification

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President to join our Alternative Investment Solutions team. This is your opportunity to join a global leader in financial services providing services to some of the world's most sophisticated institutions.

STATE STREET FUND SERVICES (SINGAPORE) PTE. LIMITED
